blind.description: A heavy medieval-style double wooden gate reinforced with iron bands. It features two upright side posts, vertical wooden planks, four horizontal iron reinforcement straps on each side studded with rivets, large ornamental iron hinge straps along the edges, a central vertical iron joining plate, a thick horizontal wooden cross-bar latch, and a small metal wicket/hatch door in the lower right section. On the reverse side, the design continues with matching iron strapping and central vertical strip. All surfaces are solid, stylized, clean, and continuous with no hovering, melted, or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A long, thin rectangular profile formed by the wooden gate panel, bounded by slightly thicker square posts at each end, with small protruding hinge rings and central latch hardware extending slightly outward from the main plane.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.1 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 6 to 6.5 ft tall) and approximately 6 to 7 ft wide.
